designationHistory.name: Lake Andes Migratory Waterfowl Refuge
designationHistory.indexText: Established Feb. 14, 1936, as the Lake Andes Migratory Waterfowl Refuge by Executive Order 7292, signed by President Franklin D. Roosevelt.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Lake Andes National Wildlife Refuge, About Us
American Presidency Project: Executive Order 7292, Feb. 14, 1936
Federal Register: Lake Andes NWR Complex final CCP notice, Apr. 24, 2013

review.note: Year confirmed. FWS planning documents add that the refuge was formally established in 1939, when South Dakota granted an easement.

designationHistory.indexOriginal: The Refuge was established in 1936 with the purchase of 365 acres of land in the Owen's Bay area.
